Pre Ops.label: BOP Default
Pre Ops.desc: NON ACTIVE DUE TO SAFETY EVENT
Pre Ops.com: Pre-task brief for task. ID LAI and consider LSRAs via SWC.

Pre Ops.label: BOP Default
Pre Ops.com: NU adaptor flange, single Type-81 BOP loaded w/ 2-7/8" rams, flow cross w/ hydraulic & manual gate valves, double gate BOP loaded w/ (1 set) blind/shear rams & (1 set) blind rams, single Type-U BOP loaded w/ 2-7/8" rams, annular and Washington head.  Torque all studs to spec.

Pre Ops.label: BOP Default
Pre Ops.com: Function tested all BOP rams.  Performed accumulator draw down test.  Good test.  Filled stack and pressure tested all rams (2-7/8" test subs) to a max of 4,500 PSI & low of 250 PSI for 5 min each.  Good tests.  Pressure tested annular (2-7/8" test subs) to a max of 2,500 PSI & low of 250 PSI for 5 min.  Good tests.

Pre Ops.com: Pre-task brief for task. ID LAI and consider LSRAs via SWC.

Pre Ops.label: MIRU Rig Default
Pre Ops.desc: NON ACTIVE DUE TO SAFETY EVENT
Pre Ops.com: Crew conducted PTB over MU/ BHA & RIH w/ WS.  Verified COFO operating properly & correct elevators utilized.

Pre Ops.label: BHA No Motor
Pre Ops.com:
Measured & MU BHA #1, torque all connections to spec.
BHA:  4-5/8" Varel SlipXtreme cone bit, bit sub, dual float sub (2 flapper back pressure valves installed, V&V'd float direction)

Pre Ops.label: BHA Yes Motor
Pre Ops.com: Make up and function test BHA #1, torque all connections to spec. XXXX psi @ X bpm & XXXX psi @ X bpm

Trip in Hole.com: RIH w/ BHA #1 on  2-7/8" PH-6 WS; fill tbg every 50 jts

Trip in Hole.desc: NON ACTIVE DUE TO SAFETY EVENT

Trip in Hole.label: TIH Default
Trip in Hole.desc: NON ACTIVE DUE TO SAFETY EVENT
Trip in Hole.com: Pre-task brief for pressure testing washington rubber and beginning drilling ops

Trip in Hole.label: TIH Default
Trip in Hole.com: Break circulation. Pressure test Washington rubber to 1,500 psi & negative test Float Valves to 1,500 psi - good test on both

Trip in Hole.label: TIH Yes Aphron
Trip in Hole.com: Circulate Aphron to surface before cont. TIH to KP.

TD well at XX,XXX';  CWC & displaced Aphron.
Marker on surface; PU w/o rotation: XX k-lb.

TD well at XX,XXX';  CWC

Trip Out of Hole.label: TOH 10 KWF
Trip Out of Hole.com:
TOH laying down WS (XXX jt 2-7/8" PH-6).
NOTE: Set/test COFO before TOH. Killed well on the fly w/ XXX bbl 10ppg NaCl

Trip Out of Hole.label: TOH Top Kill
Trip Out of Hole.com:
TOH laying down WS (XXX jt 2-7/8" PH-6).
NOTE: Set/test COFO before TOH. 
Stop at jt XXX; Kill well with: XX bbl 10ppg on tbg & XX bbl 10ppg NaCl on annulus. Top kill with XX bbl 11.6ppg on tbg and XX bbl 11.6ppg CaCl on annulus. Confirm 0psi SICP.
Cont. TOH.

Trip Out of Hole.com: TOH laying down WS (XXX jt 2-7/8" PH-6) to jt 80

Trip Out of Hole.label: TOH Yes Snub
Trip Out of Hole.com: Bullhead XX bbl 10ppg NaCl. MIRU Goliath RASU.

Post Ops.com: Conduct PTB on rigging down the rig floor and rig.
Rig down tubing handling equipment, rig floor and support equipment.
Remove BOP stack and flow cross.
Install production tree and test hanger seals.
Pressure test production tree and casing valves. Verify test results.
